variety_description: A high yielding, late maturity, short-bold, semi-dwarf, widely adaptable variety extensively grown in India under Irrigated lowland conditions. Developed by ANGRAU (Maruteru) and released in 1980 for planting in the states of Southern and Eastern India. Low nitrogen responsive with tolerance to low soil phosphorus level. Excellent grain and eating quality with low glycemic index. High HRR. Resistant to leaf blight. Susceptible to leaf blast, sheath blight, BPH & gall midge.
